issues.description: The `cad docs materials` section never states that the insert's flush top face and the coaster's recess floor/wall count as 'touching' rather than overlapping; I had to run `cad clearance` to confirm it (it reported touching, 0 mm).
Section render shows both parts in similar tints, so the PLA/TPU boundary is only visible as a thin dark line; hard to confirm flush top visually (numbers from cad clearance confirmed it).

suggestions.suggestion: Put a minimal recess + inlay example in the docs; the task here is the canonical case.
Have `cad export` print a one-line confirmation of the 3MF mode used (multimaterial vs objects), and mention when it comes from cad.toml.
A one-line 'inlay in a recess' example in the materials docs would speed up the first attempt.
Mention in the Materials docs that a cylinder cut with at=(0,0,z) is the idiomatic way to make a recess and a matching insert part.
Section renders could use distinct colours per part material.
